# Pull request

## Reason and changes

Explain the problem, final behavior and affected paths.
Link the issue when one exists.
Compare its acceptance criteria with the delivered evidence.

## Validation

List actual checks and their results.
Identify reused evidence and explain why the inputs and tools are unchanged.
Record failures, unsupported checks and NOTRUN checks explicitly.
For documentation changes, report source comparison and relative links.
Also report template frontmatter, rendering and whitespace checks.

## Limits and review

State compatibility and host validation limits.
Confirm evidence contains no keys, authenticated URLs or private paths.
Remove personal data.
Request independent review of the complete posted change.
